'''Mesh armor''' was a more advanced form of [[Reinforced fiber armor|fiber armor]] produced by military contractors
across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It used the engineering principles of fiber armor, enhancing them with high-quality materials and extensive research. Mesh armor was heavier and more cumbersome than fiber armor and conferred many of the same benefits of fiber armor and traditional suits of armor. Examples of such armor include [[GenoHaradan mesh armor]] and [[Verpine fiber mesh|Verpine Fiber Mesh]].
